controls.name: reuse-requires-high-bit
controls.reason: A continuation without the high bit must be replaced, even if its saved label looks resumable.

controls.name: reuse-clears-high-bit
controls.reason: A reused continuation clears the high bit before dispatching its saved label.

controls.name: first-suspension-label
controls.reason: The first API suspension resumes at label 1 and must still perform the second call.

controls.name: second-suspension-label
controls.reason: The second API suspension resumes at label 2 and proceeds to the next widget.

controls.name: retain-label-two-dead-identifier-cast

controls.name: retain-dead-list-casts
controls.reason: Both resumed branches retain their unused saved-list check-cast instructions.
